integrity: A finite verifier is ancillary; infinite-family proof is a direct decomposition and Mayer-Vietoris argument. No external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary Mycielskian of C_n for n>=5 only; maps from induced subcomplexes into ambient integral H2, not intrinsic H2 of all deletions. General ambient suspension is prior art; independent checking not performed.
title: Parity-controlled integral homology supports in Mycielski cycle neighborhood complexes
